Apple Integrates Alibaba AI in China Macs

Apple has integrated Alibaba's Qwen AI model into its Mac computers in China. This move aims to enhance the competitive edge of Apple's products in the Chinese market. The integration allows Siri on Mac devices in China to utilize the capabilities of Alibaba's AI. This development positions Apple to better compete with local AI offerings within China.
